entry_type.description: The entry type to look back on. Entries published a year ago today are used.

body_field.description: The field that holds the entry's text, which the AI reads.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the throwback post is drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field on that entry type where the post goes.

card_title.description: The heading on the picture card.
card_title.example: On this day, a year ago

footer.description: A line at the bottom of the card, such as your website address.

timezone.description: The time zone for the 8am daily run, for example `America/New_York`.
